patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Changes the Nagram XF launcher name and optionally replaces its launcher icon.

options.description: The display name shown under the launcher icon.
Adds .morphe to the package name, so this APK installs separately from Nagram XF.
Choose one of the launcher icons included in Nagram XF.
Optional folder containing custom adaptive icon files. When set, this overrides the built-in icon.
